segs.text: And I'm Mr. Cosmo! Welcome back to our space classroom!
Do you remember the seven days of the week?
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday!

segs.vis: 標題 What day is today?
segs.text: Great! Today, we will learn how to ask about the day, and how to answer.
今天我們要學怎麼問「今天星期幾」，還有怎麼回答。
Here is our question. What day is today?

segs.vis: card:What day is today?；What day 發光
segs.text: Look at "What day". What day means...

card:What day is today?；today 發光；img:today-noon
segs.text: And look at "today". Today is this day, right now!

card:What day is today?；整句下方出現「今天星期幾？」
segs.text: 合起來，What day is today? 就是「今天星期幾？」

segs.text: Great! Remember, the question ends with a question mark.

segs.vis: card:What day is today?；Nova 看向 Cosmo
segs.text: Mr. Cosmo, what day is today?

segs.vis: card:It's Friday.；It's 拆成 It is
segs.text: Look at "It's". It's is a short way to say "It is".

segs.vis: card:It's Friday.；i 飛走、撇號飛進來
segs.text: It's 就是 It is 的縮寫。把 is 的 i 拿掉，換成一個小撇號，就變成 It's。
所以 It's Friday 和 It is Friday 意思一樣，都是「今天是星期五」。
Repeat after me. It is Friday.

segs.text: 回答時，星期幾的第一個字母要大寫，最後別忘了句點。

segs.vis: card:What day is it?；What day is today? 在上方
segs.text: We can ask in another way. What day is it?

segs.text: The two questions mean the same thing.

segs.vis: card:What day is it?；it 發光＋「今天這一天」
segs.text: What day is it? 也是問「今天星期幾？」這裡的 it 指的是「今天這一天」，不用翻成「它」。

card:What day is it?；Your turn! 換你唸！
card:What day is it?；答句 It's Friday. 接在下方
segs.text: And the answer is the same. It's Friday!
Let's practice together. What day is it?
My turn. What day is today?
Awesome! Now let's go to five places in our day.

segs.text: Now let's watch Amy and Ben. Listen carefully!
仔細聽，他們說今天星期幾？
Good morning, Amy! Do you have your crayons?
It's Wednesday. We have art class today!
Oh, no! My crayons are at home.
It's OK. You can use my crayons.
Good morning, Amy! Do you have your crayons?
It's Wednesday. We have art class today!
Oh, no! My crayons are at home.
It's OK. You can use my crayons.

segs.text: Oh, no! I'm late for school!
No school! Let's play basketball in the park.

segs.text: Game time! Look at the calendar. What day is it?
Next one. What day is it?
Last one. What day is today?

segs.vis: card:What day is today? / What day is it?
segs.text: Today we learned two questions. What day is today? What day is it?
問「今天星期幾」可以說 What day is today? 或 What day is it?；回答用 It's 加上星期幾。
